title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few weeks before KAITO's anniversary
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, that settles it! We'll do a big surprise for KAITO's anniversary☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Be sure to keep it a secret from him, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Somehow, I don't think I should be here for this conversation...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what we thought, too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we figured that someone might accidentally let it slip... And you'd find out eventually, no matter how careful we were.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, we will be surprising you for your anniversary, but we're counting on you to not look too closely into what that surprise will be!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All this to say... Starting today after our show rehearsal, we'll be putting our surprise together on the stage. Be a dear and don't get too close, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand. I'll be over there working on ideas for our next show, then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! Look forward to it, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (A surprise for me... That makes me so happy. Everyone's putting in so much thought for my sake...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I do wonder what they have planned, but that will have to wait until the day of.)
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's KAITO☆
Hi, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku and the others asked us to stop by. Do you know where they are?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They should be on the stage right now. Ah, but I won't be able to join you over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems they're working on a surprise for my anniversary. They're using the stage for it, so they've asked me to stay away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... It sounds like they've taken Rui's advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Advice?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They actually approached us for help with your surprise a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We all know that keeping secrets isn't Miku and the others' strong suit, so I suggested they be open with the matter and ask you to cooperate.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That said, we'd feel bad leaving you on your own like this. That's why we also organized for a little extra help...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hello there! We're the helpers... KAITO's Playmates!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hi there♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: KAITO's Playmates?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ It's a special task force we put together so you won't be bored and lonely all by yourself☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm a member of the task force today, too☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right! Every day, one of us will switch in to help out♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll leave it to you for today, Emu. We should go help Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆
se_walk_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know, KAITO! The KAITO from our world uploaded a preview for his own anniversary concert♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna watch it with you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The version of me from your world? That sounds fascinating. I'd be happy to watch it together.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We wanna watch, too!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I'm gonna sit on KAITO's lap!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Then I'll sit on his shoulder!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa... Be careful not to fall, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm pressing play!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm excited already.
KAITO's anniversary

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come, KAITO, your throne awaits! The best seat in the house, front and center!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you. After all the hard work you've done, I'm really looking forward to this surprise.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The plushies have kept me company every day since then.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Not only KAITO's Playmates, but KAITO's Chat Buddies and KAITO's Relaxation Friends too...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Everyone has done so much for me already. I truly am fortunate.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now that the star has made his entrance, I think it's time to begin.
Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hm? Everyone seems a little different from usual...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have a letter of appreciation written for you today! I hope you'll listen as we read it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A letter of appreciation?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Dearest Mr. KAITO! Thank you for always guiding us as our troupe leader.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “We all love making fun shows. So whenever we think of a fun idea, we always tell you right away.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “And no matter what ideas we have, you always smile and listen to us. That makes me really happy!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, my turn!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Even when an idea is too silly or sounds impossible at first, you give it some real thought.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “You're always so dependable, and we're proud you're our troupe leader. We'll keep working hard to put on the best shows ever with you!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “You always look out for us all, even when it comes to things unrelated to shows.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “Whenever we need help, you're there to lend a hand. All of us owe you so much.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “But remember, we want to be there for you, too. If you're ever in need, come and lean on us.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Let us repay you for everything you do for us. You'll have all of us right behind you!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And last is me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Thank you for everything you do, KAITO! Let's put on lots and lots more shows together. We'll be friends forever and ever!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for this wonderful surprise.
I'm so happy, my heart feels like it might burst.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, looks like our surprise was a big success☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's all thanks to Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm so pleased to see your surprise succeed! But we were only your assistants.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was your heartfelt letter, written with utmost care, that brought your feelings of gratitude to KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You all worked really hard on it, after all. You spent so long finding the perfect ways to say how you felt.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you all so much. I love it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Save the happy tears, my friend. You still have a party to attend!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You even planned a party?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, everyone! We're all done setting up!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: It's right over there, so let's go, let's go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: R-Right. I'm coming.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Great! We'll be your escorts to the venue. Right this way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make this a super great party for KAITO☆

rows.Speaker: Nene, Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It wasn't just that surprise, they even set up a party for me...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This really is a special anniversary indeed.)
